_about: Card text for the project page. build.py lists every skill in .claude/skills/; this file only gives each one a group, a one-line summary, a 'just say' example and an optional badge. A skill missing here still appears, under 'More', with the first sentence of its own description. Keep it plain: no jargon a non-editor wouldn't know.

groups.title: Cut
groups.blurb: From raw recording to a clean first cut.

groups.title: Fill
groups.blurb: Extra clips, graphics, the line you forgot.

groups.title: Polish
groups.blurb: Your notes, cleaner sound, steadier shots.

groups.title: Home videos
groups.blurb: The trip, the dog, the birthday.

aroll-draft.line: Cuts the retakes, stumbles and "is this thing on?" out of a recording of you talking. No clipped words.
aroll-draft.say: cut the retakes out of my-take.mp4

multicam-angles.line: Filmed with two cameras? Picks the best angle for every moment.

talking-head-ffmpeg.line: Puts your extra clips over the talking and renders the video. No editing app needed.

unboxing-cut.line: Turns a long unboxing into a short, satisfying sequence.

broll-brick-layer.line: Covers the talking with matching clips on your DaVinci Resolve timeline, then double-checks every pick.

broll-library.line: Every clip you've ever shot, described and searchable.
broll-library.say: have I ever shot a rainy street?

motion-graphics.line: Animated numbers, charts and labels that pop up as you say them.

vo-gapfill.line: Forgot to say something? Fills the gap with a line in your own text-to-speech voice.
vo-gapfill.say: do a voiceover for that gap

camera-ab-compare.line: Two phones, one walk: builds the side-by-side comparison video.

edit-review-notes.line: Watch your draft, jot notes as you go, and Claude makes the changes.

resolve-export-draft.line: Renders a draft of your DaVinci Resolve timeline to watch anywhere.

voice-clear.line: Takes the echo and background noise out of your voice, on your Mac.

stabilize-clips.line: Smooths shaky phone clips, and keeps the original if it didn't help.

ship-it.line: From approved draft to ready to upload, in two words.

youtube-release.line: Titles, a description with chapters, and the volume set right for YouTube.

youtube-thumbnails.line: Thumbnails made from your real footage, with words from your own video.

studio-thumbnails.line: More thumbnail ideas from YouTube Studio's and Gemini's AI.

shorts.line: Finds your best moments and turns them into captioned vertical Shorts.

home-video.line: Turns a pile of trip, pet or family clips into a movie with music. Can keep every frame private on your Mac.
home-video.say: make a video of our trip

montage-music.line: Picks songs that fit the mood and times them to the cuts.
montage-music.say: pick a song for this part

footage-triage.line: Sorts a messy folder of clips into the right places. You approve every move.

archive-project.line: Done with a video? Keeps what matters and frees up the space. Asks first.

new-project.line: Sets up a tidy folder for your next video.

setup.line: A few skippable questions, so everything knows where your stuff lives.

customize.line: Say "from now on..." and it remembers. Or ask it to change how anything works.
customize.say: from now on, keep my jokes

editing-coach.line: Learning to edit? Ask anything and get step-by-step answers and feedback.

aroll-benchmark.line: For tinkerers: scores the automatic cut against your own edit.
aroll-benchmark.say: score the auto cut against my edit
